idle.note: the protagonist's cut-out bob: torso, head and both free arms drop 2 px and return as one rigid group; pelvis, legs and feet still

move.note: a plodding step-to: the camera-side leg (stride) takes one full-tile step with a 6 px stomp lift and a bent knee, the other leg (trailing) steps up to meet it; the pelvis drops 3 px as each foot lands and the torso jolts 1 px after it; the arms swing opposite the legs like heavy pendulums

refraction.note: opens its chest: it rocks back and swings both fists out and up to the sides, then heaves the chest forward to present the ice mirror along the line (contact: the existing Refraction beam), holding with a 1 px shudder and bent knees; then settles

guard.note: raises both fists to a boxer's guard either side of the ice mirror (elbows folding), sinks 2 px into its knees and leans back 2 degrees; at the contact the fists clash 4 px inward toward each other as the ward lands; holds; lowers

hit.note: spec hit: torso knocked 3 px back and 1 px down with a 3 degree lean back, head nods back 4 degrees, both fists trail 1 px; recovered by 0.6

death.note: the cold goes out of it: a 1 px lurch up, then the knees buckle over planted feet (pelvis down 20 px and 5 forward), the torso pitches forward 20 degrees, the head tips 15, and both fists drop to the floor ahead; terminal pose held, then the existing fade
